description: A modular, stack-agnostic toolkit for AI coding agents to autonomously find, reproduce, and patch vulnerabilities.

written.description: Reads a codebase and its commit history, builds a threat model from them, and sends agents to chase each hypothesis it raises. It then tries to reproduce each finding in a sandbox and attacks its own patch to check the fix holds, working from source alone with no running target.

Features

  • client: describe the type, message, code and details of API errors
  • client: list each method's errors without their descriptions

Updates `pydantic` from 2.14.2 to 2.14.3
Release notes

Sourced from pydantic's releases.

v2.14.3 2026-11-04

v2.14.3 (2026-11-04)

What's Changed

Packaging

  • Build wheels for GraalPy 3.13 by @​msimacek in #14136.

    The previous v2.14.2 release published GraalPy 3.11 wheels, which were not working due to a PyO3 version bump. A CI workflow issue made it so that the wheel wasn't tested before publishing. This is now fixed: starting in v2.14.3, we no longer publish GraalPy 3.11 wheels, and GraalPy 3.13 wheels are now published together with the existing 3.12 one.

Performance

  • Improve schema generation for fixed type handlers by @​alexmojaki in #14130
  • Skip general schema dispatch for builtin scalars by @​alexmojaki in #14141
  • Skip annotation handler setup when annotations are empty by @​alexmojaki in #14149
  • Fix quadratic serialization time with per-index include/exclude on sequences by @​Viicos in #14160
  • Avoid type lookups when checking for None during serialization by @​Viicos in #14167
  • Improve performance of model serialization by @​Viicos in #14171
  • Improve performance of dict serialization by @​Viicos in #14172
  • Improve performance of type inference during serialization by @​Viicos in #14173
  • Avoid cloning the field name when using the default value during validation by @​Viicos in #14175
  • Do not evaluate model_config annotations by @​Viicos in #14195
  • Avoid slow runtime Protocol check when expanding GroupedMetadata annotations by @​Viicos in #14196
  • Use a lightweight @contextmanager implementation internally by @​Viicos in #14199

Fixes

  • Fix various issues about GC tracking in pydantic-core by @​Viicos in #13819
  • Include null in serialization JSON Schema for unless-none field serializers by @​Kropiunig in #13848
  • Fix RecursionError when copying or unpickling models with defer_build by @​Viicos in #14115
  • Remove dead default_factory check in unsupported Field() attribute by @​owtaylor in #14129
  • Disallow non string extra keys during validation by @​Viicos in #14135
  • Fix deeply nested data being reported as a cyclic reference by @​Viicos in #14164

New Contributors

  • @​owtaylor made their first contribution in #14129
